title: Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms
abstract: arXiv:2611.21706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. translated_title: 荷兰两个奶牛场群养犊牛的视频录像与玩耍行为标注数据集
translated_abstract: 玩耍行为被用作奶牛犊牛积极福利的指标，但公开可用的群养犊牛视频及个体行为标注十分稀缺。我们描述了在荷兰两个奶牛场的犊牛群养栏中四次摄像机部署（每次约一周）所拍摄的视频：一个研究教学型奶牛场（2024年和2025年）和一个商业奶牛场（2024年）。录像包含1,173个视频文件，总时长651小时。在八个观察日中，训练有素的观察员使用Noldus The Observer XT软件对犊牛行为进行连续编码，采用包含玩耍及其他行为的18项行为谱，涵盖104小时的视频，其中90小时对栏内每头犊牛均进行了编码。本次发布还包含来自七个标注会话的110万解码帧、通过光学字符识别从烧录在每帧中的摄像机时钟读取的逐帧时间戳、每头犊牛的分割轨迹以及逐犊牛帧级玩耍标签。这些数据支持……
tldr: 该论文发布了一个开放数据集，包含荷兰两个奶牛场群养犊牛的651小时视频录像以及个体层面的玩耍行为标注，为犊牛积极福利研究提供宝贵资源。
en_tdlr: This paper releases an open dataset comprising 651 hours of video recordings of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms with individual-level play behaviour annotations, supporting research on positive animal welfare.
